headline: Kyrgyzstan's 2027 budget allocates 1.3 billion soms for pension increases
summary: Kyrgyzstan's 2027 budget provides 1.3 billion soms for raising pensions, according to the head of the Social Fund, reported at a session of the Jogorku Kenesh.
why: Budget allocations for social spending indicate fiscal priorities and influence public finances and domestic demand.
original_headline: В бюджете КР на 2027 год заложено 1,3 миллиарда сомов на повышение пенсий
